title: Product weight of coordinate restrictions
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite type, let $\delta\in\mathbb{R}$, and assign to each $i\in\iota$ a coordinate restriction $\rho(i)$. The product weight of this assignment is the product, over all $i\in\iota$, of the weight at parameter $\delta$ of the restriction $\rho(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate restriction assigned to each element of $\iota$
